name: Salyut Agents – AI Chatbot & Lead Generation Agents
author: 5paceracedigital

sections.description:
Most website visitors leave without ever telling you what they wanted. Salyut Agents changes that.

Salyut Agents is a free AI chatbot for WordPress, built for lead generation. It puts a team of AI chat agents on your site — each with its own name, role, and objective — that talk to your visitors, answer their questions, understand what they need, and capture them as briefed, contactable leads. Whether you sell services, products, or both, every conversation becomes usable sales and support intelligence, saved right in your WordPress dashboard.

It works around the clock, on every page, without you lifting a finger.

A different specialist on every page

Most chatbots run one generic bot across your whole site — the same script everywhere. But one bot can’t be a great salesperson and a great support agent and a great product guide, because a single prompt can only hold so much.

Salyut Agents lets you assign a different agent to any page. A sales agent on your product pages. A support agent on your help pages. A qualifier on your services page. Each one has its own instructions, its own goal, and even its own AI model — so every visitor gets exactly the right conversation for exactly where they are. This is what makes Salyut Agents different, and it’s included.

What Salyut Agents does

  • Builds a team of AI agents — each with a name, avatar, role, and objective. Assign them per page, or run one agent site-wide.
  • Captures leads through natural conversation — optionally collect name, email, and phone before the chat begins, turning anonymous traffic into a contactable list.
  • Saves every conversation as sales intelligence — full transcripts stored as lead records in your dashboard, so your team knows what each visitor needs, considered, and objected to before they follow up.
  • Qualifies leads, triages, and routes — instruct agents to gather budget, timeline, or project type and only hand off visitors who meet your criteria, sending each enquiry to the right place.
  • Runs on Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT models — connect Anthropic, Google, and/or OpenAI through the AI Connectors built into WordPress 7, and pick the best model per agent: a fast, low-cost model for FAQ triage, a reasoning model for technical support, whichever writes best for sales.
  • Persistent across your site — the conversation follows visitors as they browse, keeping full context instead of resetting on every page.
  • Agents work as a team — when a visitor reaches a page with a different agent, they can switch to that specialist or carry on with the current one.
  • Fully customizable design — brand colours, avatars, welcome messages, and a legal disclaimer with links to your privacy policy and terms.
  • Bot & cost protection built in — an invisible honeypot, timing checks, per-visitor rate limiting, and optional Cloudflare Turnstile guard the point where conversations start costing money, so automated traffic can’t run up your AI bill.

You bring your own AI provider account. Salyut Agents connects to your own account with Anthropic, Google, and/or OpenAI. You pay the provider directly at their standard rates — there’s no markup and no conversation limits imposed by Salyut Agents. You stay in full control of your spend.

Set up in minutes. Install the plugin, connect a provider under Settings → Connectors, and enable the chat to go live with three ready-made agents you can customise or replace. No developer required.

Build as many AI agents as you need — there’s no limit.

The plugin’s JavaScript ships as complete, unminified source — there is no build step required to read or modify it.

Plugin home: https://salyutplugins.com/salyut-agents/

Documentation and support: https://salyutplugins.com/salyut-agents/documentation

External services

Salyut Agents connects to third-party services to function. It’s important you and your visitors understand what data is sent, to whom, and when.

AI providers (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI)

Salyut Agents sends conversation data to whichever AI provider(s) you choose to connect (Anthropic’s Claude, Google’s Gemini, and/or OpenAI’s GPT). When a visitor sends a message, that message — together with the conversation history and the instructions and business-context notes you configure on the agent — is transmitted to your selected provider so it can generate the AI’s reply. This happens every time a visitor interacts with the chat. No conversation data is sent to any provider until you connect one and a visitor begins chatting.

You connect these providers using your own account credentials, and your use of each is governed by that provider’s terms:

  • Anthropic (Claude) — Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms — Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google (Gemini) — Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms — Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • OpenAI (GPT) — Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use — Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Cloudflare Turnstile (optional)

If you enable the optional Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection, two things happen: the visitor’s browser loads Cloudflare’s Turnstile script, which collects browser and interaction signals to tell humans from bots; and the visitor’s IP address and a challenge token are sent to Cloudflare’s servers to verify the visitor before a conversation starts. This only happens if you turn Turnstile on; it is off by default.

  • Cloudflare — Terms: https://www.cloudflare.com/terms/ — Privacy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

Salyut Agents does not send your data anywhere else. The plugin itself does not phone home to any Salyut Agents server.

Third-party libraries

Salyut Agents bundles Action Scheduler, version 4.1.0 (https://actionscheduler.org/, https://github.com/woocommerce/action-scheduler), used to run background jobs. It is a code library only — it does not send data anywhere.

Privacy

Salyut Agents stores data in your own site’s database — never on a Salyut Agents server.

When a visitor uses the chat and is captured as a lead, the plugin stores:

  • The contact details the visitor provides — name, email address, and/or phone number. Which of these are asked for is up to you; lead capture is entirely optional and can be turned off completely.
  • The visitor’s IP address, used only to enforce anti-abuse rate limits on the chat.
  • The full text of the chat conversation, the page it started on, and timestamps.

Leads are stored as a private custom post type plus post meta; transcripts are stored in a custom database table ({prefix}salyut_agents_messages). This data is kept until you delete the lead. When you delete the plugin, the data is kept by default so a reinstall is seamless; there is an opt-in setting to delete all Salyut Agents data on uninstall.

Salyut Agents registers with WordPress’s core privacy tools: a visitor’s stored data can be exported (Tools → Export Personal Data) or erased (Tools → Erase Personal Data), matched by email address, and the plugin adds suggested text to your site’s Privacy Policy editor.

Chat messages are sent to the AI provider you connect so the assistant can reply, and — only if you enable Cloudflare Turnstile — the visitor’s IP is sent to Cloudflare. See “External services” above.

You are responsible for disclosing this processing to your visitors (for example, in your site’s privacy policy) and for any consent your jurisdiction requires.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Connect at least one AI provider (Anthropic, Google, or OpenAI) using your own account credentials, under Settings → Connectors.
  3. Salyut Agents comes with three ready-made agents — customise them, or create your own.
  4. Choose whether the chat appears site-wide or only on specific pages, and assign agents where you want them.
  5. Turn on the chat with the main enable switch to go live.

Salyut Agents requires WordPress 7.0 or higher and your own account with at least one supported AI provider.
sections.faq:
Is Salyut Agents free?

Yes. The plugin is free, with no paid tiers, trials or locked features. The only running cost is your AI provider’s usage, which they bill you for directly. Salyut Agents adds no per-message or monthly fee.

How is it different from other AI chatbot plugins?

Most chatbot plugins run one bot across your whole site. Salyut Agents gives you a team of AI agents, each with its own role, prompts and AI model, and lets you assign a different one to any page: a sales chatbot on product pages, a support agent on help pages, a lead qualification agent on your services page.

Does it use the WordPress 7 AI Client?

Yes. Salyut Agents is built on the AI Client in WordPress 7.0 core. You connect your AI provider once under Settings → Connectors, and the plugin never stores your API key itself.

Can I use a different chatbot on each page?

Yes. Open the page in the editor and, on the Page tab (not the Block tab), choose an agent in the Agent Settings panel. You can also set it with Quick Edit on the Pages list. Any page without an assignment uses your default agent.

What happens when a visitor moves to a page with a different agent?

The conversation keeps its full context. The visitor can switch to that page’s agent or carry on with the one they’re already talking to.

Do I need my own AI provider account?

Yes. Salyut Agents connects to your own account with Anthropic, Google, and/or OpenAI, and you pay that provider directly at their standard rates. This keeps you in full control of your usage and spend, with no markup and no conversation limits imposed by Salyut Agents.

Which AI providers and models are supported?

Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), and OpenAI (GPT). You can connect one, two, or all three, and choose which model each agent uses — so you can run a fast, inexpensive model for high-volume triage and a more capable model where it matters.

Is my data sent anywhere?

Yes — conversation data is sent to whichever AI provider you connect, so it can generate replies, and (optionally) visitor IPs are sent to Cloudflare if you enable Turnstile bot protection. Please see the “External services” section above for full details. The plugin does not send data anywhere else.

How many agents can I create?

As many as you need — there’s no limit. Assign them to different pages, each with its own role, objective, and AI model.

Will it email me about new leads?

Only if you turn it on. Email notifications are off by default. When enabled (Settings → General → Notifications), Salyut Agents emails the site administrator a once-daily digest of new leads — and only on days when a new lead has actually come in.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Salyut Agents works alongside WooCommerce and any other WordPress setup — you can place a sales or product agent on your shop and product pages.

Do I have to collect visitors’ personal data?

No. Lead capture is entirely optional. You can run Salyut Agents as a pure support or engagement tool with no data collection, or enable name, email, and/or phone capture when you want to build a contactable lead list.

What happens to my data if I uninstall?

By default, nothing is removed when you delete the plugin, so your data is intact if you reinstall. If you prefer a clean removal, there’s an option to delete all Salyut Agents data (leads, conversations, agents, and settings) when the plugin is deleted.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: Chat Widget Height setting in the Design settings. Choose Default or set a custom height (400-900px). Existing sites keep their current widget height until you change it.
  • Improved: Clearer admin notice when an agent’s AI provider is disconnected. Settings now shows the resolved default model and lets you change it.
  • Improved: More strings are translatable, including settings tabs, preset avatar labels, the disclaimer and newsletter defaults, and the seeded starter agents.
  • Fixed: Agents now always call the exact model they are configured for.
  • Fixed: The typing indicator could get stuck, and empty or card-only replies could be treated as failures.
  • Fixed: The widget could scroll backwards, or show content above restored history, when switching agents.
  • Fixed: Uninstalling could leave some options and user meta behind.
  • Dev: New hooks for add-ons: read-only tool use (with a request timeout and model-support detection), agent hand-off from a tool, card renderers, the final system prompt, privacy export fields, rate limits, and admin branding (display name, tagline, header logo, origin story).

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
